messages:
maria: anyone know where to pull traces + request-id logs for /v1/generate? I see a tiny 4xx bump around 09:02 UTC and need route breakdown + a couple sample traces to triage. also which dashboard shows 4xx by route + top client IPs?

devon: pinging @ops-oncall — for traces we usually go Tempo/Jaeger and search by request_id or tag route=/v1/generate. Grafana has the per-route error panels under 'Errors -> Routes'.

jess: dash link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abc123/errors-routes (panel: "4xx by route" & "Top client IPs")

jess: quick Loki query to get request_ids and counts (adjust time range):
```
{job="gateway"} |= "GET /v1/generate" | logfmt | request_id!="-" | count_over_time(5m)
```

kai: once you have a request_id, paste it into Tempo search (or Jaeger): search service=gateway AND tag.request_id=<id> — that'll give you the span tree + downstream latencies. If the trace isn't sampled, use the timestamp from the log and look for adjacent spans (trace_id) in logs.

srebot: [alertbot] route_errors_4xx triggered on gateway-prod (3 hosts) — threshold: 5% over 5m. See alerts page: https://alerts.redwood.com/route_errors_4xx

devon: note: a lot of noise is from 429s (rate-limiter). For alert tuning we usually exclude 429 or alert on 4xx client-error-rate with >=5% over 10m, and add a suppression for known bot user-agents. happy to propose a change if you want.

jess: if you want sample logs for specific client-ip or user-agent: tweak Loki like so:
```
{job="gateway"} |~ "(GET|POST) /v1/generate" | json | user_agent =~ "BadBot|curl" | count_over_time(5m)
```

ops-oncall: I'm looking now. if you can drop one request_id i can pull the full trace + annotated logs and attach. runbook for route 4xx triage: https://runbooks.redwood.com/route-4xx-triage

maria: thanks — grabbing one now, will post the id in ~5m :thumbsup:

devon: also a quick long-term fix: add route and client_ip as labels at ingress so graphing/top lists are cheaper. cc @jess for dashboard change.

jess: can add a "Top 4xx paths" panel and a filtered heatmap for client_ip -> route. will put up a PR for dashboard changes later today.

ops-oncall: posted a sample trace and flattened logs for request_id=abcde-12345; pasted into thread: https://tempo.redwood.com/trace/abcde-12345 and attached span screenshot. looks like a downstream 400 from validator-service.

maria: got it, thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a little repro case and open a ticket if validator-service needs a fix. :eyes:
